title: the decoy of the instrument sees the copy of the chain that resolves in its own environment
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D0) for the second time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 90 to 92 named one finding that touches it (F28).  The code of the pipeline is honest; the proof was blind.  The wave touches no code of the pipeline and no file of the site.  (1) **The decoy was blind to a copy of the chain that resolves the instrument by the profile** (F28): the decoy ran in a hermetic environment (the home of the user empty, the store of nix empty), so only the step of the environment and the step of the PATH resolved there; a copy of the chain that looks the instrument up in the profile of the user fell back to the chain of the repository silently, the pipeline took the instrument from that copy, and the check answered 0 -- a proof that is green on a tree whose pipeline does not do what the claim says.  (2) **The environment of the decoy is the environment of a normal run**: all four steps of the chain resolve there -- the variable of the environment, the command on the PATH, the binary of the profile of the user and the glob of the store of nix -- and every one of them resolves to the instrument of the machine and not to the decoy; the chain of the copy is the only thing that hands out the decoy.  (3) **The boundary of the probe is named**: the decoy sees a copy that resolves the instrument in the environment of the decoy, and it does not see a copy that resolves it in a place that the environment of the decoy does not provide; such a copy is seen by the textual probes when it writes a step of the search in the words of the code, and a step that is assembled on the fly is not seen by them either.  The objection (d) of wave 91 said that the behavioural probe sees a copy only if the copy shadows the chain, and that was false -- a copy that shadows the chain and resolves the instrument was not seen.  (4) **The textual probes read all the scripts and the requirement has teeth**: the probe of the steps of the search reads every file of `scripts/` and not one, and the probe of a second chain looks for a function that carries two or more kinds of steps under any name and not only under the name of the chain; the requirement of the mark of the decoy is a function that must be able to fail, that counts the pictures it is asked about and that refuses a check that asked it about nothing; and the check reads its own words and refuses a file of itself in which the section of the decoy is gone.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the check runs the pipeline in a copy of the tree and reads the pictures it wrote, but the pictures of the site itself are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is four prices.  (a) The decoy proves that **the pipeline of that copy** takes the instrument from the chain: a pipeline that takes the instrument from the chain for one diagram and searches for it by itself for another is seen only in part, and the check demands the mark in every picture of the copy, so a part that searches for itself is caught -- but a part that searches for itself and draws a picture that is not in the copy is not.  (b) The probe reads the **code** of the files of `scripts/', not the trace of the runtime: a step assembled on the fly (`c=comm; $c -v plantuml') is not seen, and that is named.  (c) The decoy costs a run of the pipeline, so the check is slower than it was: the file of the check is 1341 lines and 57.0 kB (the wave 91 one was 1165 lines and 47.9 kB) and it goes in 24 to 26 seconds.  (d) **The boundary of the behavioural probe is named and it is not the boundary of the wave 91**: the decoy sees a copy of the chain that **resolves the instrument in the environment of the decoy**, and it does not see a copy that resolves it in a place that the environment of the decoy does not provide; a copy that hides its step from the textual probes and does not resolve in that environment is invisible to the decoy, and the textual probes see it only when it writes a step of the search in the words of the code.  The wave 91 named this boundary in the words "the behavioural probe sees it only if the copy shadows the chain", and those words were false: a copy that shadows the chain and resolves the instrument was not seen, as the discriminator of the package of the waves 90 to 92 showed.
refuted_by: a step of the chain of the search does not work alone, or the chain of the search is copied in a second place, or the pipeline does not read the chain from the place where it lives, or the pipeline writes a step of the search of a tool by itself, or the pipeline takes the instrument from anywhere but the chain of the search, or the pipeline renders one theme only, or a diagram of the tree is not drawn, or a picture is not drawn from its own source, or a picture is drawn from a part of its source, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the tool is not there, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when PlantUML fails or writes no picture, or the skins of the themes do not carry the colours of the site, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes' is the same, the text says that the decoy is measured in the environment of a normal run and names the boundary of the probe in the words "the decoy sees a copy that resolves the instrument in the environment of the decoy"; the `falsifier' is the same, and the `control' is the same.  Nineteen controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-21 -- eleven by the writer of the wave and eight more by the parent, and the parent's eight were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 24 to 26 seconds.  (2) **The finding F28 itself**: a second chain in `scripts/lib/other-tools.sh' that resolves the instrument by the profile and is asked before the chain of the repository -- before the wave the check answered 0, and the marker proved that the pipeline took the instrument from that copy; now the code 1, and the check says both things that are true: the file of the copy writes a step of the search of a tool by itself, and the pictures of the tree of the decoy do not carry the mark of the decoy.  (3) The same copy with the step of the environment and with the step of the store -- the code 1 in both cases.  (4) **The parent's own controls, made independently**: the copy of the chain was masked so that the textual probes do not see it (the name of the profile was assembled on the fly), and the decoy caught it alone -- the code 1 with the refusal of the pictures; a copy that resolves nothing in the environment of the decoy -- the code 0, because a refusal that the tree does not deserve is a refusal with a false subject; the requirement of the mark was made never to be asked -- the code 1 with the refusal "the requirement of the mark of the decoy was asked about 0 pictures and not about the 4 pictures of the tree of the decoy"; the registered control of the claim -- the code 1.  (5) The same mutations were run against the files of the checks of the waves 89 and 91, and those answered 0 where the new one answers 1: the place of the finding is measured and not a story about it.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 1341 lines and 57.0 kB (the wave 91 one was 1165 lines and 47.9 kB); the files of the pipeline and of the site were not touched by this wave, and the branch holds four commits.
